Australian organisations are increasingly recognising cybersecurity as a serious business risk, with new research showing more than a third of industrial organisations see it as a major obstacle to growth. Separately, the University of Sydney is now offering free ChatGPT Edu access to all students and staff, which may prompt other Australian educational institutions to consider similar moves — along with the data privacy and acceptable-use policies that should accompany them.

Businesses using AI tools should be aware that poorly managed AI agents can generate unexpected and significant costs if left unchecked. **Practical tip:** If your organisation uses AI-powered tools, make sure spending limits and usage alerts are configured to avoid surprise bills.
